title: DeFi Llama TVL Rankings
description: Fetches the top DeFi protocols ranked by Total Value Locked (TVL) from DeFi Llama. TVL is the single most important metric in DeFi - it represents real capital committed to a protocol. Captures current TVL, 1d/7d/30d TVL changes, chain distribution, category, and mcap-to-TVL ratio. A low mcap/TVL ratio (under 1.0) may signal an undervalued protocol.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
from datetime import datetime, timezone

BASE = 'https://api.llama.fi'
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

resp = requests.get(f'{BASE}/protocols', timeout=30)
resp.raise_for_status()
protocols = resp.json()

slice_end = min(len(protocols), 200)
rows = []
for i in range(slice_end):
    p = protocols[i]
    tvl = float(p.get('tvl', 0) or 0)
    mcap = float(p.get('mcap', 0) or 0)
    change_1d = float(p.get('change_1d', 0) or 0)
    change_7d = float(p.get('change_7d', 0) or 0)
    change_1m = float(p.get('change_1m', 0) or 0)
    mcap_tvl = round(mcap / tvl, 4) if tvl > 0 else 0.0

    chains = p.get('chains', [])
    chain_str = ','.join(chains[:10]) if isinstance(chains, list) else str(chains)

    rows.append({
        'rank': i + 1,
        'protocol': p.get('name', ''),
        'slug': p.get('slug', ''),
        'symbol': str(p.get('symbol', '') or '').upper(),
        'category': p.get('category', ''),
        'tvl_usd': round(tvl, 2),
        'change_1d_pct': round(change_1d, 2),
        'change_7d_pct': round(change_7d, 2),
        'change_30d_pct': round(change_1m, 2),
        'mcap_usd': mcap,
        'mcap_tvl_ratio': mcap_tvl,
        'chains': chain_str,
        'chain_count': len(chains) if isinstance(chains, list) else 0,
        'staking': float(p.get('staking', 0) or 0),
        'listed_at': p.get('listedAt', 0),
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
